text:
ada (design): quick check-in  proposing a small-but-different approach for eval approvals: add a lightweight "Snapshot preview" before you commit a recorded sign-off, and rename the recorded action to "Record & annotate" so it invites a short note. Intent: reduce accidental audits and improve post-hoc traceability.

ryan (product): love the preview idea. two questions: does preview persist with the audit record or is it ephemeral? and is annotation required?

ada: typo — ada meant persist. preview is a compact read-only view of what will be archived; when you Record & annotate, snapshot is saved with optional 1-3 line note (required only for orgs with strict compliance).

lucy (eng): backend: we can add a snapshot store and link it from the audit event. event name: evals.record_annotate.v1. payload: user_id, mode: quick|record, prompt_set_sha, count, snapshot_url?, note?. We'll gate full snapshot storage behind feature flag and per-org policy to control costs.

omar (a11y): accessibility perspective: preview must be reachable by keyboard and announced. propose a "Preview snapshot" button that opens an alertdialog with role="dialog" and aria-labelledby. Add a skip-link to jump from results list to the preview to avoid long tabbing. For Record & annotate, the 1-3 line composer must be accessible (labelled textarea, maxlength announced).

frank (uxresearch): in intercepts, reviewers worried they couldn't tell what changed in a snapshot. Preview helped them feel confident. The annotation prompt increased accountability and improved note quality in tests. People tolerate a short required note when compliance is on.

ada: copy ideas (compact):
- Primary: Quick pass
- Secondary: Record & annotate
- Secondary tooltip: Save a snapshot and add a short note to the audit record
- Preview CTA (inside secondary flow): Preview snapshot
- Confirm modal title: Record & annotate X items
- Confirm body: Snapshot will be stored. Add a short note (optional). This action is recorded and audit ID will be created.

ryan: prefer shorter secondary text in UI: "Record + note"? but keep full phrase in tooltip.

ada: ok try "Record + note" in the compact affordance. tooltip keeps the phrase.

omar: a11y nit: tooltips alone are not enough. add aria-describedby linking to a visible short consequence text and make preview openable via keyboard. When snapshot is saved, announce via aria-live polite: "Snapshot saved. Audit ID: XYZ. Note saved." and focus the toast so keyboard users can find the audit link.

lucy: keyboard shortcuts: Mod+Enter = Quick pass, Mod+Shift+Enter = Record + note. For preview, allow Enter while secondary focused to open preview. Telemetry: include trigger: ui|shortcut|preview. For large bulk ops (>250), automatically open a compact preview with a compressed diff to avoid huge archives; store full archive in S3 and include archive_url.

frank: testing plan: 6 users for discoverability, 3 for preview usefulness, include 2 screen reader participants. Track mistakes: how often preview is opened vs not, and how many records include a note.

ada: QA checklist for PR:
- focus order: toolbar -> primary -> secondary -> preview -> confirm -> result toast
- preview dialog: labelled, keyboard focus trapped, summary of changes (not full dump)
- composer: labelled textarea with maxlength announced; if org requires note, error state reads via aria-live
- toast: role=status, keyboard focusable, includes audit id link with aria-describedby
- shortcuts: both work, preview trigger works
- bulk: preview shows compressed diff + archive_url returned in event

omar: extra: add data attribute data-a11y-preview on preview button and data-a11y-record on record button for testing assertions. Also include an accessible cancel button in the preview dialog that is first in tab order.

lucy: dev estimate: UI + preview dialog + shortcuts ~3d, backend snapshot & archive + event ~2d, feature flag gating + admin toggle ~1d, QA ~1d. We'll scope to behind flag.

tool-bot: Created issue #5588: "evals: snapshot preview + record-and-annotate flow" and assigned to lucy.

ryan: rollout: behind org-level feature flag. default keep current behavior. Beta to a large compliance customer first. Metrics: preview open rate, fraction of records with notes, accidental record rollback (undo), time-to-complete.

ada: action items: @lucy open event schema PR and branch, @omar add a11y checklist to PR template, @frank schedule 6 moderated sessions (include SR users). I'll update figma with preview frames and copy variants. Target: branch tomorrow.

lucy: ack, branch tomorrow and will draft schema.

omar: will PR checklist.

frank: invites sent.

ada: thanks all ":sparkles:",
